summary: Implemented every stub in babel/plural.py (operand extraction, PluralRule parse/rules/tags, the rule tokenizer, parser, and JavaScript, Python, gettext and Unicode compilers, range helpers, cldr_modulo), babel/languages.py, babel/messages/mofile.py (read_mo, write_mo), babel/messages/setuptools_frontend.py (check_message_extractors) and babel/units.py (unit lookup, format_unit, compound units), and fixed a Python 3.10 syntax error in the plural _RULES regex. The last full-suite run (with --continue-on-collection-errors) gave 149 passed and 506 failed, with 6 errors; the remaining failures in my files need CLDR locale data that is absent from this checkout, and the setuptools failures come from frontend.py and the environment.
